finding: The generic comparator was later hardened to require both Vapor-on control and candidate outputs finite. Re-running the original pathological VT04 case then fails because control_finite=false and candidate_finite=true.
authority: The frozen original F-PDI-VT04 preregistration required candidate finiteness, Vapor-on activation and NoVap identity; it did not require control finiteness. Therefore this post-close rerun does not retroactively change or fail VT04.
